lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Hello, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Sorry for being so abrupt,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: but can you help us?

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Please.
What's wrong?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: you're probably going to

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: find this very strange,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: but we're preparing for a parade.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Hehe.
A parade? When? Where?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: A week from now at Ark Square.
No kidding.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: We've confirmed that the situation in the Ark will calm down soon,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: so we're planning on holding a parade once they do.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Everyone's on edge, and we figured this would help them relax.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I know this is all very sudden,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: but we want to get the parade underway as soon as we know the situation is all clear.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: That's why we're preparing so thoroughly.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: We decided the square would make for the perfect place for a rehearsal,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: since it's nice and spacious enough to accommodate a large parade.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: The only thing is...
There are Raptures in the square.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Precisely.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: I know it may sound absurd,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: but Blanc and I

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: have always felt that Coin Rush provides an important service to the people.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: The Central Government is insisting everything is fine,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: but many buildings have collapsed, and people have lost their lives.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Many people are mourning,

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: and we want to give them a moment where

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: they can forget all their sorrows, even if it's just for a moment.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: This is what Coin Rush and

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: the Tetra Squad were meant to do.
Leave it to me.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Thank you, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Truly.
